### Added
- **`components.gateway-api-crds`: the Gateway API CRDs for a cluster that has none** (giantswarm/cluster-manager#183). The fleet's `gateway-api-crds` chart (`>=1.9.1 <2.0.0`, 1.9.1 is Gateway API v1.6.1, standard channel) into `kube-system`, off by default: a management cluster runs it as its own app. The connectivity release and agentgateway `dependsOn` it, so on a workload cluster without the Gateway API the models Gateway and its routes install after the CRDs instead of failing on the missing kinds; off, the reference is dropped. cluster-manager turns it on in the serving slice of such a cluster. The customer BOM pins 1.9.1.
